title: billing / wallet.debited (v1) data payload
description: Billing (stored-value ledger SoT) DEBITED a wallet for a spend — a balance debit modelled on the bus, NEVER a fresh online card charge (Round 17, ADR-0011). Published to 'billing.events' with routing key 'wallet.debited'. Consumed by Frontend (balance read-model), Bar/POS (local balance copy), Control Room. Partial spend supported; insufficient balance is not represented here (the remainder falls back to normal POS payment). VAT is accounted at this spend via Billing's existing document logic (MPV).

amount.description: Amount debited, currency MINOR units (integer cents).

balanceAfter.description: Authoritative wallet balance after this debit (ECST).

ref.description: Reference to the charge it settled (e.g. orderId, tabId, bookingId), when applicable.

at.description: When the ledger applied the debit (RFC3339 UTC).
